use_retry_api_calls_decorator: use the retry_api_calls decorator to automatically retry OCP API calls on transient failures
configure_rate_limit_logging: configure RateLimitLogging dataclass to log rate limit events with a custom logger and action description
create_custom_wait_strategy: create a _wait_check_retry_after wait strategy that respects retry-after headers from rate limit responses
set_unlimited_retries: set max_attempts to NO_LIMIT in retry_api_calls to retry API calls indefinitely
customize_retry_wait_times: customize fixed_wait_sec and max_jitter_sec parameters in retry_api_calls to control retry timing
